boards.name: New York
boards.ces: Optional: TruMerit CVS for New York, or school sends Form 2F
boards.note: Pathway 5 for IENs. Take NY-approved infection control and child abuse courses first. No exam until NYSED approves you.

boards.name: Illinois
boards.ces: TruMerit CES, ERES, JS&A, TEC, or IEE
boards.english: Needed if your program was not in English: TOEFL, IELTS (6.5, Speaking 7), OET, PTE, or MET
boards.note: No SSN? File the SSN affidavit. Fingerprint within 60 days of applying. Register for the NCLEX through CTS.

boards.name: Texas
boards.ces: CES Full Education Professional report, sent by the evaluator
boards.english: Needed if your program was not in English: TOEFL iBT 83, IELTS 6.5 (6.0 each), PTE 55 (50 each), MET 55 (Speaking 55), or OET 300 in each part (one sitting, no remote tests)
boards.note: Pass the Texas Jurisprudence Exam before your ATT is issued. You must have worked in the last 4 years or graduated within 4 years.

boards.name: Florida
boards.ces: Full Education Course-by-Course report: CGFNS/TruMerit, ERES, JS&A, IEE, SpanTran (TEC), or Ashland
boards.english: Needed if your program was not in English: IELTS 6.5 (Speaking 7), TOEFL iBT 76, PTE 55, MET 55, or OET 300
boards.note: You can apply and test without an SSN. You need one before the license is issued. Livescan fingerprints required.

boards.name: California
boards.ces: Not required. School mails transcripts to the BRN.
boards.english: TOEFL may be required if you are from a non-English-speaking country or did not take your licensing exam in English. The BRN packet gives no minimum score.
boards.note: SSN or ITIN is mandatory. BRN does its own course review; gaps must be made up before the exam. Fingerprints required.

boards.name: Washington
boards.ces: TruMerit CES Professional, ERES, IEE, JS&A, or TEC
boards.english: Required unless exempt: TOEFL iBT 4.0 (Speaking 4.5), IELTS 6.5 (6.0 each), OET 300 L/R/W + 280 Speaking, MET 55 (Speaking 55), or CELBAN (L9, R8, W7, S8). PTE not listed.
boards.note: Fee is $138 single-state or $203 multistate. No SSN? Submit the No SSN form. FBI fingerprint check required.

boards.name: New Mexico
boards.ces: Course-by-course: TruMerit CES Professional, JS&A, or ERES
boards.english: Needed if your program was not in English: TOEFL, TOEIC, IELTS, OET, or MET
boards.note: Upload your visa or passport after applying. Fingerprints via IdentoGO. A $50 multistate fee started June 1, 2026.

boards.name: Montana
boards.note: Apply online. Fingerprint check through the Montana DOJ is required.

boards.name: New Jersey
boards.ces: TruMerit CES Professional or Certification Program letter
boards.english: Sent to TruMerit: TOEFL iBT 83 (Speaking 26), IELTS 6.5 (6.0 each), OET 300 R/W/L + 350 Speaking, or TOEIC. Educated in some countries (e.g., UK, Canada outside Quebec, Australia)? Exempt.
boards.note: SSN and a copy of the card are required. You may test before the background check clears, but you cannot work yet.

boards.name: Pennsylvania
boards.ces: Board-approved foreign credentials evaluator (TruMerit lists CES Professional)
boards.english: Needed if your program was not in English: a Board-approved test
boards.note: No SSN? File the SSN waiver. Take 3 hours of approved child abuse training. Multistate license costs $250 for IENs.

boards.name: Arizona
boards.ces: TruMerit CES, Certification Program letter, VisaScreen, or other approved evaluator
boards.english: Needed if your program was not in English: TOEFL iBT 84 (Speaking 26), IELTS 6.5 (6.0 each), PTE 55, or VisaScreen
boards.note: You must show lawful presence; SSN needed if you live or work in the U.S. Fingerprints required ($50).

boards.name: Georgia
boards.note: You need one active foreign license when the CES is issued. Graduated over 4 years ago? Show 500 hours in 4 years.

extra: NY infection control and child abuse courses
Verify license via Nursys or Form 3
IENs: CES report or TruMerit/VisaScreen/JS&A certificate
No English test if you passed the NCLEX

CA.hours: No hours rule; license must be active
extra: Live Scan in CA, or hard cards ($49) from outside CA
Transcripts sent directly from school, evaluator, or another board
No SSN? Submit the No SSN form
IENs may be asked for a CES, eDas or VisaScreen letter
3 hours of approved child abuse training
IENs: CES, CP letter, or VisaScreen

GA.hours: Graduated within 4 years, or 500 hours in the last 4 years, or a reentry course
extra: GAPS/Idemia fingerprints on the same day you apply
